notes: The public demo of SearchForAlpha Lab, not the research workspace. One Python container: waitress serves the Dash app that demo/server.py builds. Type is 'node' only because the pipeline has no Python type; the Dockerfile here is custom and ignores BUILD_COMMAND/START_COMMAND. Reads demo/fixtures/ -- a frozen snapshot of 12 tickers (daily bars from 2006, hourly for two years, SEC/Yahoo fundamentals) committed in the repo -- and never a vendor: demo.sealing refuses outbound sockets and yfinance in-process. The order path is absent: ib_async is not installed, lib/live/ is deleted in the image, and importing it is refused. Email-gated: a verified address gets a 7-day trial (demo/access/); the SMTP account (DEMO_SMTP_*, DEMO_MAIL_FROM) and DEMO_ADMIN_TOKEN live in /opt/sites/alpha/.env, and the demo refuses to start without the mail settings. demo.sealing opens outbound sockets to that one SMTP host:port and nothing else. Per-visitor dashboard state lives in memory and expires after 30 idle minutes; Optuna studies go to a tmpfs; the only durable state is the access/usage SQLite on the access-data volume (/app/data), read at /admin. The container is capped at 2 CPUs and 1.5 GB on top of the demo's own run caps and per-IP rate limits (DEMO_* in compose.yml). maxBody is 24m because the Data table round-trips its JSON payload. Kill switch: DEMO_MODE=false in compose.yml, redeploy -- every page 404s and /healthz still answers.
